title: ATS Jobs Board Extractor Input (Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby)

boards.title: ATS Boards (Objects, Board URLs, or provider:slug)
boards.description: List of target job boards as objects (e.g. {"provider": "greenhouse", "slug": "stripe"}), full board URLs (e.g. "https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe", "https://jobs.lever.co/spotify", "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/linear"), or shorthands ("ashby:linear").

remoteOnly.title: Remote Jobs Only
remoteOnly.description: When enabled, return only jobs classified as workplace_type='remote'.

keywordFilter.title: Keyword Filter (Optional)
keywordFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter matched against job title, department, team, location, tech_tags, and description_text.

departmentFilter.title: Department / Team Filter (Optional)
departmentFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter matched against normalized department and team names.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max Jobs Per Board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Maximum number of matching job records to output per ATS board.

requestDelayMs.title: Polite Delay Between Boards (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive ATS board API requests. 429/503 responses automatically trigger Retry-After backoff.
